profile.headline: Software Engineer @ Prudential Financial  |  Masters of Business and Science student at Rutgers University
profile.summary:
Hi everyone! I am currently working towards my Master of Business and Science degree at Rutgers in Analytics. I'm seeking a position where I can employ both my technical capabilities and my reasoning, analytical, and decision-making abilities. I would want to work in a setting that encourages me to gain new knowledge and abilities while still being welcoming.

I am a person with a spotless academic record and the capacity to get along with others. I am a fantastic team builder, have the capacity to operate in a fast-paced workplace, and am technically skilled.
I look forward to connecting with you all here on LinkedIn.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Developed and managed dozens of RESTful API proxies, products, and developer apps for
securely connecting the internal/external applications and databases to the target/backend vendor
services. (Apigee Edge, Postman, BitBucket, Jenkins)
- Developed complex integration services for connecting and translating SOAP, XML, and JSON
data between internal/external business applications through secure API proxies to backend
systems. (IBM Integration Bus Toolkit, SOAPUI, Jenkins, XMLSpy, BitBucket,
BeyondCompare, eSQL, JSON, XML, SOAP)
- Collaborated with multiple cross-platform agile teams through all phases of the Software
Development Life Cycle for various projects while applying industry best practices
positions.insights: Skills: Jenkins · Bitbucket · Agile Project Management · JFrog Software · Artifactory

positions.title: Data Science Extern via Rutgers MBS Externship Exchange
positions.description:
- Enhanced fundraising strategies using advanced data analysis, including R programming, time-series analysis, and Gradient Boosting Machine models.
- Forecasted 2025 donation trends to optimize campaign timing and maximize donations.
- Analyzed donor retention and engagement data to identify high-impact periods for outreach.
- Delivered actionable insights to improve donor retention and boost community engagement.
positions.insights: Skills: Time Series Forecasting · Collaborative Leadership · R (Programming Language) · Data Analysis

positions.title: Pharmacy Technician
positions.description:
- Under the supervision of the pharmacists, prepared labels and filled prescriptions and performed safe and appropriate pharmacy services.  
- Truck inventory scan-in, continuous record-keeping of inventory through use of talon system, and distribution of goods to the floor.
- Managing cash registers and double-counting end-of-day sums when prompted to.

positions.title: Extern
positions.description:
- Enhanced business skills including project management, communication, working remotely, and marketing technology to various groups.  
- Refined leadership development skills such as networking, branding, and management through webinars and fast - paced online learning.

positions.title: Tutor
positions.description:
- Mentored students in general subjects of Mathematics and Reading Comprehension.
- Efficiently managing 10-12 students at a time alongside providing assistance for their homework, in-class exam preparation and standardized test preparation (PARCC, SAT, ACT, etc.). 
- Coordinated with supervisory staff to conduct lesson planning and scheduling and evaluated scores for students.

volunteerExperiences.description:

projects.title: Airline Reservation System
projects.description: Fully functional dynamic web project using AWS, MySQL and JSP pages. It provides the functionalities of the admin, customer representative, customers to reserve or buy tickets, search and even sort flights in preference of fare and most frequent.
